exact_signature:
theorem actual_mixture_densities {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let μ := orthogonalHaar n
    let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
        Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
          (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let qpos : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νpos
    let qneg : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νneg
    (∀ x, 0 ≤ qpos x ∧ 0 ≤ qneg x) ∧
    Measurable qpos ∧ Measurable qneg ∧
    Integrable qpos volume ∧ Integrable qneg volume ∧
    (∫ x, qpos x) = 1 ∧ (∫ x, qneg x) = 1 ∧
    νpos.bind γ = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (qpos x)) ∧
    νneg.bind γ = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (qneg x))

definition_audit.review: Seal-assigned definition must be exactly ((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T). Its implementation was not opened; source agreement is assessed from the sealed meaning. SPD and inverse covariance facts are internal consequences/providers.

definition_audit.name: orthogonalHaar n
definition_audit.review: Canonical normalized Haar on the full real orthogonal group, including both determinant signs. Canonical existence/uniqueness characterization is assigned, not re-audited from implementation.

definition_audit.name: nupos,nuneg
definition_audit.review: Exactly 2 times mu restricted to det=+1 or -1; conditioning a half-mass event gives this normalized probability. No SO(n)-only base, unnormalized restriction, or independent prior variable.

definition_audit.name: gamma
definition_audit.review: Actual Mathlib multivariateGaussian with mean zero and matrix covariance A_O inverse; its actual law is the source Gaussian, with canonical assigned density identity. No placeholder distribution.

definition_audit.name: p
definition_audit.review: sqrt(det A_O)/(2*pi)^((n:Real)/2) * exp(-(x dot (A_O*x))/2). The source names the actual Gaussian density; its complete formula is a standard implicit expansion. The assigned GaussianLawDensity provider must certify actual law equality.
definition_audit.source_formula_status: standard-Gaussian formula implicit in the source density convention; complete sealed body is explicit

definition_audit.name: qpos,qneg
definition_audit.review: Selected pointwise real Bochner averages under the actual conditioned priors. Source p_b is only determined Lebesgue-a.e. by its actual law. This is honest source-implicit elaboration provided inner absolute integrability is established for every x and actual withDensity equality/L1/mass1 are proved. It is not a source claim that all arbitrary p_b choices equal q_b pointwise.

definition_audit.name: volume / withDensity(ofReal q)
definition_audit.source: R^n Lebesgue dx in A2.Ex56/A2.Ex68 and the actual-density convention
definition_audit.review: Standard Euclidean Lebesgue base. Pointwise q>=0 ensures ofReal does not hide negative truncation. Actual measure equality certifies the representative; Integrable q and integral q=1 certify a genuine finite real density.

formula_checks.detail: Exponent is ((n : Real) / 2), not natural division n/2; n=3 yields 1.5. No odd-dimension restriction or floor occurs.
Precision-density factor sqrt(det A_O)/(2*pi)^(n/2), exponent -x^T A_O x/2, covariance A_O inverse.
Both priors are exactly twice restrictions of the same canonical full Haar; half masses/probability are internal canonical outcomes.
EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n), WithLp.ofLp coordinates, usual dot/matrix action and its canonical volume must match the assigned actual Gaussian-density identity.

Real Bochner integral is totalized in Lean. Target conclusions alone do not document every inner integrand is integrable. The semantic contract additionally requires proof of pointwise inner L1 for every x; outer L1 and mass1 must likewise be proved genuinely, not read from an unevaluated integral.
Only four audited binders occur; all measurability, SPD, probability, Fubini, positivity, L1, actual-law and mass premises are absent.
